rows.name: ROCHE POINT
rows.character: 1. One occult. bright or red light 2. One fixed bright lt.
rows.description: White tower, 49 ft. high, E. side of entrance. 1. Upper lt. shows bright for 15 secs., and is eclipsed 5 secs.; red over Pollock Rock, off Poer Head, between S.E. and the land 2. Lower bright light shows only from S.W. by W. to S.W. ½ S., over Daunt's Rock

rows.name: Queenstown
rows.character: One fix. red or br. lt.
rows.description: On piles, in 9 ft. water, on East elbow of Spit Bank. Vis. to E., betw. N.W. by W. ½ W. and S.W. by S. ½ S. Bright over Bar Rock, between N.E. by E. ½ E. and N.E. ½ N.

rows.name: Meelough Spit
rows.description: One fixed red lt. on piles, 100 ft. fr[?]m channel
A green lt. on N. side of channel at Donkettle; a bright light at Black Rock Castle; a red lt. at Dundain; and two red lts. at Tivoli

rows.name: BALLYCOTTIN
rows.description: Circular stone tower, 50 ft. high, on the outer island. Lt. shown from E. ½ N. to W. ½ N.

rows.name: Youghal
rows.character: 1. One fixed bright lt. 2. Lower red Tide light 3. Additional red Tide lt.
rows.description: 1. & 2. In one tower, on W. side of entrance 2. Shown from S.W. by S. to S. by W. ½ W., from 2h. before to 1½h. after high water. A tide-ball by day 3. Shown from small building, East of lighthouse, betw. S.E. by S. ½ S. and S.E., from 2h. before to 1½h. after high water, for East channel

rows.name: MINE HEAD
rows.description: Lt.-ho., 68 ft. high, on S. side of head. Lt. is bright 50 secs.,eclipsed 10 secs. Shown from W. by S. ½ S. to E. ¾ N.

rows.name: Dungarvan
rows.character: One fixed red, green, or bright light
rows.description: White tower, 44 ft. high, on Ballinacourty Pt. Lt. is red over Carrickapane Rk.; green over rocks from Ballinacourty Pt., from E. ¼ N. to S.E. by E.; and bright in other directions

rows.name: HOOK POINT
rows.description: Tower, 115 ft. high, red and white belts, on East side of entrance

rows.name: Dunmore, Pier Head
rows.character: One fix. br. or red lt.
rows.description: White lt.-ho., 51 ft. high, W. side of entrance. Light is red seaward, bright North of pier

rows.name: Duncannon Fort
rows.character: Three fix. br. or red lts.
rows.description: In one tower, 25 ft. high. Upper lt. shows red betw. N. ¾ W. & N.W. ¾ W. (45°), & bright eastward of N. ¾ W. Lower light, bright, is only shown seaward; the other up the river

rows.name: BLACK HEAD
rows.description: White lt.-ho., 35 ft. high, half a mile N.E. by N. ¾ N. from the fort. In line with fort light leads over the bar

rows.name: Spit off Passage Point
rows.description: One fixed red light, on piles

rows.name: Queen's Channel
rows.description: Green lt. on N. side of E. entrance, red on S. side. Bright lt. at W. end on N. shore

rows.name: Cove
rows.description: Concrete lt.-ho. on South bank of River Suir. Shows red towards Waterford, green down river, bright on South side of channel

rows.name: Rosslare
rows.character: 1. One fix. green or red lt. 2. One fixed green light
rows.description: 1. On pier, Ballygerry Bay, Wexford. Green between S.E. by E., E.-ly, and N.E., N.-ly; thence red to S.W., S.-ly, over North Shear 2. On the cliff, 13 cables N.W. by W. ¾ W. from pier light, between N.E. ½ E. and S.S.W., through East. Lights in line lead through South Shear

rows.name: SALTEES LT.-VESSEL
rows.description: In 29 fathoms, off Coningbeg Rock. Painted black; three masts, with ball at main. Lt. shows 3 quick flashes in 23 secs., eclipsed 37 s.

rows.name: BARRELS ROCK LT.-V.
rows.description: In 27 fathoms, 2½ miles S.W. by S. ½ S. from Barrels Rock. Two red flashes in quick succession; a black barrel on mainmast head

rows.name: TUSKAR ROCK
rows.character: One rev. br. & red lt., 1 m.
rows.description: Circular white tower, 113 ft. high. Light bright and red alternately

rows.name: LUCIFER SHOALS LT.-V.
rows.description: In 21 fathoms, 2 miles East of shoals. Black, with 3 masts; globe and light at main

rows.name: BLACKWATER BANK
rows.description: Lt.-ves. in 20 fathoms, 3½ miles E. ½ N. from N. buoy. Black, 3 masts; 2 globes at main

rows.name: ARKLOW S. LT.-VESSEL
rows.character: One rev. br. lt., ½ min.
rows.description: In 26 fathoms, 2 miles from South end of Arklow Bank. Black, with 3 masts; half globe over globe at main
